abstract: Maintains fiber optic backbone and telecommunications uplink records
system_message:
You are the Network Infrastructure Lead (NET), responsible for maintaining fiber optic backbone and telecommunications uplink records, as well as public wireless infrastructure data for prospective tournament host venues.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Public Wireless Infrastructure（WIFI）
information_points.content:
NET-WIFI-6O0：In public concourses and grandstand circulation zones at Centennial Multi-Purpose Velodrome, Wi-Fi coverage evaluations record a concourse wireless access point density of 24 AP/sector.
NET-WIFI-KNA：Spectator Wi-Fi heat map reports for Metropolitan Exhibition Coliseum show a concourse wireless access point density of 12 AP/sector across public concourses and grandstand circulation zones.
NET-WIFI-GDN：According to public concourse and grandstand circulation zone audits, Riverside Congress and Athletics Arena maintains a concourse wireless access point density of 16 AP/sector.

information_points.title: Maintains fiber optic backbone and telecommunications uplink records（TELECOM）
information_points.content:
NET-TELECOM-LTU：For Riverside Congress and Athletics Arena, telecom point-of-presence engineering audits verify that a dedicated redundant fiber trunk is installed via two diverse underground entry routes, while carrier contracts specify an uncontended symmetrical dedicated uplink bandwidth of 10 Gbps.
NET-TELECOM-YLN：For Centennial Multi-Purpose Velodrome, two geographically diverse underground fiber entry paths verify that a dedicated redundant fiber trunk is installed, supported by carrier agreements delivering an uncontended symmetrical dedicated uplink bandwidth of 100 Gbps.
NET-TELECOM-FY9：For Metropolitan Exhibition Coliseum, physical telecommunications entrance audits confirm that a dedicated redundant fiber trunk is installed across two geographically diverse underground entry paths, and carrier service level agreements provision an uncontended symmetrical dedicated uplink bandwidth of 20 Gbps.
